findings.title: Direct LLM calls bypassing model router in emergency alert intelligence module

evidence.observation: Direct invocation via call_gemini using GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable instead of routing through model router
Direct invocation via call_mistral using MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variable instead of routing through model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency_alert_service to dispatch LLM requests through the centralized model router endpoint.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures uniform policy enforcement, telemetry, fallback handling, and rate-limiting across all LLM queries.

findings.title: Missing call log file for active model router

evidence.observation: Model router is reachable and configured for log_file '/opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl', but call_log_exists is false

proposed_action.description: Verify model router write permissions and directory existence for call_log.jsonl to enable call telemetry logging.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility and historical call telemetry for model routing operations.
